purpose: Form DIR-3A is used for providing a declaration when the applicant's name does not have a last name, so that their father's or grandfather's surname is mentioned in the last name for the DIN application.
who: Every applicant who intends to be appointed as director of an existing company
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Download Form DIR-3 from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal.
Fill in the required particulars, verify, and sign the form.
Attach the required documents including photograph, proof of identity, proof of residence, board resolution, and verified specimen signature.
Scan and file the entire set of documents electronically.
Sign and submit Form DIR-3 electronically using the applicant's Digital Signature Certificate.

Get the form verified digitally by a company secretary in full time employment of the company or by the managing director, director, CEO, or CFO of the company where the applicant is intended to be appointed.
checklist: Board resolution proposing appointment as director in an existing company
Declaration in Form No. DIR-3A if the applicant's name does not have a last name
Digital Signature Certificate of the applicant
Digital verification by the company secretary, managing director, director, CEO, or CFO
attachments: board resolution proposing his appointment as director in an existing company
watch: In case the name of a person does not have a last name, his or her father's or grandfather's surname shall be mentioned in the last name along with the declaration in Form No. DIR-3A.
